in_sanskrit.name: चन्द्रनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the lord or master of the moon.

in_marathi.name: Chandranath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandranath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandra (Moon) + Nath (Lord, Master). The name Chandranath is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of the Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often considered a deity and is a symbol of calmness, stability, and fertility.
